llama3.1-8b.name: llama3.1-8b
llama3.1-8b.notes: Ultra-fast 8B parameter model on CS-3 hardware. 32K context (paid tier), 8K output. Supports tool calling and structured outputs. Same underlying model as Groq 'llama-3.1-8b-instant' and SambaNova 'Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct'.

llama-3.3-70b.name: llama-3.3-70b
llama-3.3-70b.notes: High-performance 70B parameter model. 128K context, 65K output (paid tier). 2100 tokens/sec inference speed. Same underlying model as Groq 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile' and SambaNova 'Meta-Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct'.

gpt-oss-120b.name: gpt-oss-120b
gpt-oss-120b.notes: 120B parameter model with reasoning capabilities. 131K context, 40K output (paid tier). Supports tool calling, structured outputs, and reasoning_effort parameter. Fastest inference at ~3000 tokens/sec. Same underlying model as Groq 'openai/gpt-oss-120b' and SambaNova 'gpt-oss-120b'.

qwen-3-32b.name: qwen-3-32b
qwen-3-32b.notes: 32B parameter model with hybrid reasoning mode. 131K context, 8K output. Supports tool calling, structured outputs, and /no_think command to disable reasoning. ~2600 tokens/sec. Same underlying model as Groq 'qwen/qwen3-32b' and SambaNova 'Qwen3-32B'.
